steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:aubergine}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} into chunks.
Put a wide pan on a medium heat with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Add {{ing:curry-paste}}. Fry 2 minutes, until it smells strong.
Pour in {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Stir until smooth.
Add the aubergine. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pepper and {{ing:green-beans}}. Cook 6 minutes.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} in 600 ml water, covered, 12 minutes.
Add {{ing:fish-sauce}} to the curry. Taste.
Squeeze {{ing:lime}} in.

swaps.text: Lemon

recipes.name: Prawn noodles
recipes.method_note: Everything happens fast at the end. Have it all chopped first.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} in hot water 8 minutes. Drain.
Chop {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Crush {{ing:peanuts}} roughly.
Mix {{ing:fish-sauce}} and {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} in a cup.
Put a wide pan on a high heat with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Add the garlic. Stir 30 seconds.
Push it aside. Crack in {{ing:egg-medium}} and scramble.
Add the noodles and the sauce. Toss 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:prawns-cooked}} and the spring onions. Toss 1 minute.
Squeeze {{ing:lime}} over. Scatter the peanuts.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:chicken-breast-skinless}} thinly.
Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:chilli-fresh}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}.
Put {{ing:stock-chicken}} and the ginger in a pan. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Add the chicken. Simmer 8 minutes, until white through.
Add the mushrooms and chilli. Cook 4 minutes.
Add {{ing:fish-sauce}} and squeeze in {{ing:lime}}.
Chop {{ing:fresh-coriander}} over.

recipes.name: Pork with basil and chilli, Thai style
recipes.method_note: A fried egg on top is how it is often eaten in Thailand.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}} finely. Cut {{ing:green-beans}} into short lengths.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wok on a high heat. Fry garlic and chilli 30 seconds.
Add {{ing:pork-mince}}. Fry 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the beans. Stir-fry 3 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:fish-sauce}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:fresh-basil}} until wilted. Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Plant-based mince or finely chopped mushrooms, for a vegetarian version

recipes.name: Crunchy peanut and lime slaw
recipes.method_note: Keeps its crunch for a day, so it packs well for lunches.

steps.instruction: Shred {{ing:cabbage-white}} finely. Grate {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Slice {{ing:pepper-bell}} thinly.
Whisk {{ing:peanut-butter}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}.
Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}} finely. Stir into the dressing.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Scatter {{ing:peanuts}} over.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken curry
recipes.method_note: Fry the paste in the thick top of the coconut milk first. That is where the fragrance comes from.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into bite-sized pieces. Slice {{ing:courgette}} into half moons.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wok or large pan on a medium heat.
Spoon in the thick cream from the top of {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:thai-green-curry-paste}}. Fry 2 minutes, until it smells fragrant.
Add the chicken. Stir 3 minutes, until coated and sealed.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk. Simmer (small bubbles) 10 minutes.
Add {{ing:green-beans}} and the courgette. Simmer 5 minutes, until tender but still bright.
Stir in {{ing:fish-sauce}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Tear in {{ing:fresh-basil}}. Serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Thai red curry with cauliflower and tofu
recipes.method_note: Roasting the cauliflower first gives it colour and stops it going watery in the sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Cut {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into florets. Toss with 1 tablespoon of the oil on a tray.
Roast 20 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cut {{ing:tofu-firm}} into cubes. Pat dry with kitchen roll.
Fry the tofu in the rest of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes, until golden.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Add {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}} to the tofu pan. Fry 1 minute.
Pour in {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}. Add {{ing:pepper-bell}}, sliced. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and {{ing:spinach}}. Stir until the spinach wilts.
Stir in {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Serve with the rice. Scatter {{ing:fresh-coriander}} over.

swaps.text: Chicken thighs, browned in place of the tofu, if you eat meat
Butternut squash or sweet potato, roasted the same way

recipes.name: Massaman curry with potatoes and peanuts
recipes.method_note: Mild, rich and slightly sweet, with warm spice. A good first Thai curry for children.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:potato-medium}}. Cut into large chunks. Cut {{ing:onion-medium}} into wedges.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into large pieces.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large pan on a medium heat.
Fry {{ing:massaman-curry-paste}} 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken. Stir 4 minutes, until sealed.
Add potatoes, onion, {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and 150 ml water.
Simmer (small bubbles) 30 minutes, until the potatoes are soft.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Stir in {{ing:fish-sauce}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and most of {{ing:peanuts}}.
Squeeze in {{ing:lime}}. Serve with rice and the last peanuts on top.

swaps.text: Firm tofu, added for the last 10 minutes, or extra potato and a tin of chickpeas, to make it vegetarian
Soy sauce, to make it vegetarian or vegan

recipes.name: Hot and sour prawn soup, tom yum style
recipes.method_note: Hot, sour and salty all at once. Taste at the end and adjust with lime and fish sauce.

steps.instruction: Bash {{ing:lemongrass}} with a rolling pin. Cut into short lengths.
steps.note: Bashing releases the oils. The pieces are not eaten.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:chilli-fresh}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Halve {{ing:cherry-tomato}}.
Bring {{ing:stock-chicken}} to a simmer (small bubbles) with the lemongrass, ginger and chilli.
Simmer 10 minutes, until it smells of lemongrass.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes. Simmer 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:prawns-cooked}}. Heat 2 minutes, until hot through.
Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:fish-sauce}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Ladle into bowls, leaving the lemongrass behind. Top with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

swaps.text: Tofu and extra mushrooms with vegetable stock and soy sauce, to make it vegetarian
The grated zest of a lime if you cannot get lemongrass

recipes.name: Pad Thai with prawns and tofu
recipes.method_note: Have everything chopped and by the hob before you start. It cooks in under ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:rice-noodles-dry}} in hot water following the packet. Drain.
steps.note: Slightly firm is right. They finish cooking in the pan.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:fish-sauce}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, the juice of 1 lime and {{ing:tomato-ketchup}}.
steps.note: Ketchup stands in for tamarind: sweet and sour.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:tofu-firm}} into small cubes. Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a wok on a high heat. Fry the tofu 5 minutes, until golden.
Push to one side. Crack in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Scramble 1 minute.
Add the garlic, noodles and sauce. Toss 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:prawns-cooked}}, {{ing:beansprouts}} and most of the spring onion. Toss 2 minutes.
Serve topped with chopped {{ing:peanuts}}, {{ing:chilli-powder}}, the last spring onion and lime wedges.

swaps.text: More tofu, and soy sauce instead of fish sauce, to make it vegetarian. Leave out the egg for vegan
Toasted sunflower seeds if peanuts are a problem
